data.body:
Implementation done in worktree sunbear-ci-triggers.

AUDIT of every file in .github/workflows/ (23 files). Only FOUR have an on.push trigger; all four already used the same branches-ignore idiom, so 'tickets' was appended to each list:
- test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml: [feature/**, main] -> [feature/**, main, tickets], each with a comment citing this alias.
The remaining 19 have no push trigger: _artifact-probe/_build-and-test/_eval-discipline/_mutation/_optionality (workflow_call only), gerrit-verify.yaml + jira-dc-capability-map + jira-dc-epic-link-probe + release + structured-output-baseline (workflow_dispatch only), codeql + mirror-guard + mutation + reconcile-bridge + reconcile-bridge-canary + dependency-advisory-canary + external-integration (schedule + dispatch), terraform-drift (pull_request paths + schedule), lockdown (pull_request_target).

CORRECTION to the ticket's original finding: reconcile-bridge.yml does NOT push-trigger today (schedule '*/20 * * * *' + workflow_dispatch only), so no change was needed there.

No schedule: block was touched anywhere (git diff confirms; the new test pins the five cron literals).

Enforcement: new tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_push_policy.py ENUMERATES the workflow directory from disk (not a name list) and asserts none push-matches 'tickets', so a future workflow added with a bare 'push:' fails the gate. Verified RED: reverting test.yml alone makes it fail with the intended message. Also asserts topic-branch push CI survives (the scratch-branch push is the only pre-merge lane for a workflow edit) and that gerrit-verify stays dispatch-only via the existing sibling test.

Docs (operator scope addition): adopter-facing warning added to docs/concurrency.md 'Outbound - push (on every write)' (canonical), with cross-links from docs/user-guide.md and the sync.remote annotation in docs/config.md.

Gates so far: 12 check_* gates OK, complexity baseline --check clean, 4 generators no-diff, make lint OK, make typecheck OK, CI-tier pytest running.
